source.attribution: Mathieu Fehr, as identified by the user

groups.title: Rejection of `i0`
groups.description: Veir rejects direct scalar `i0` operands/results that MLIR accepts. This includes memory-intrinsic lengths, branch-forwarded values, and the scalar result of vector reduction; it is not a recursive check of aggregate element types.

groups.title: Missing vector forms
groups.description: Veir restricts these operations to scalar forms accepted alongside vectors in MLIR. For `llvm.select`, this restriction concerns the condition.

groups.title: Scalable vectors are not represented
groups.description: Veir cannot represent MLIR scalable vectors for these otherwise vector-capable operations.

groups.title: Different floating-point type support
groups.description: Veir accepts scalar float8 arithmetic/conversions rejected by MLIR, while its native float representation lacks f80/f128/ppc_fp128 forms accepted by MLIR.

groups.title: Different LLVM-compatible type predicate
groups.description: Veir accepts multidimensional vectors, scalar float8, and arbitrary opaque `!llvm.*` spellings, but rejects modeled LLVM byte/function types. Its recursive array check also differs from MLIR’s outer-type predicate.

groups.title: Missing LLVM-compatible value-type checks
groups.description: Veir accepts non-LLVM value types that MLIR rejects, such as `index`: results of poison/undef/zero/freeze, selected values of select, and bundle operands of assume.

groups.title: Properties accepted on operations that declare none
groups.description: Veir accepts and discards supplied `<{...}>` properties; MLIR rejects them on these operations.

groups.title: Unknown property keys rejected
groups.description: Veir rejects unknown `<{...}>` keys that MLIR’s generated property conversion ignores. Memory intrinsics make exceptions for their explicitly tolerated bundle keys.

groups.title: Overflow-flag decoding
groups.description: Veir accepts invalid overflow-flag bits, but rejects MLIR’s custom attribute form and non-i32 integer storage.

groups.title: Incomplete fast-math flag representation
groups.description: Veir represents only `nnan`, `ninf`, and `nsz`; other MLIR fast-math flags are unsupported or lost.

groups.title: Fast-math properties ignored entirely
groups.description: Veir ignores malformed `fastmathFlags` rejected by MLIR and drops valid flags.

groups.title: Missing access-group, alias-scope, and TBAA checks
groups.description: Veir misses metadata element-kind checks performed by MLIR’s AccessGroupOpInterface/AliasAnalysisOpInterface and ODS constraints.

groups.title: Missing atomic memory checks
groups.description: Veir discards ordering and misses MLIR’s atomic ordering, type, explicit-alignment, and syncscope rules.

groups.title: Missing dereferenceable metadata checks
groups.description: Veir ignores malformed dereferenceable metadata rejected by MLIR. On load, it also misses DereferenceableOpInterface’s pointer-result restriction.

groups.title: Overly strict argument/result attribute lengths
groups.description: Veir requires exactly three `arg_attrs` entries and zero `res_attrs` entries; MLIR does not verify these lengths.

groups.title: Relaxed shift operand types
groups.description: Veir accepts unequal operand widths and byte-type left operands rejected by MLIR’s operand constraints and type-matching trait.

groups.title: Aggregate verification stops at structs
groups.description: Veir skips the remaining path, bounds, and value/result-type checks once traversal reaches a struct, including opaque structs MLIR cannot index. It also lacks full LLVM-container compatibility checks; insertvalue additionally lacks the primitive-value restriction, and extractvalue can produce non-LLVM results.

groups.title: Different handling of oversized aggregate indices
groups.description: Veir rejects large indices that MLIR’s unsigned bounds comparison can wrap, such as 4294967296 for an array of length one. This is a source-observed edge case.

groups.title: Symbol resolution and uniqueness ignore scopes
groups.description: Veir uses context-wide lookup instead of MLIR symbol-table scopes. This can resolve unrelated symbols or reject legal repeated names. Its global/comdat/function checks also miss some containing-table cross-kind collisions and symbol visibility constraints.

groups.title: Register compatibility used instead of exact type equality
groups.description: Veir can accept register-compatible types where MLIR requires exact equality for forwarded or returned values.

groups.title: Missing branch-weight validation
groups.description: Veir misses MLIR’s prohibition on all-zero weights. For switch, it also misses the requirement that nonempty weights match the successor count.

groups.title: llvm.mlir.constant
groups.description: Veir compares float widths instead of semantics, accepting a bf16 value with an f16 result. Veir misses dense payload/count validation, scalable-splat requirements, nested-array element checks, and general LLVM result-type restrictions. Veir rejects dense integer width changes, float-to-integer dense reinterpretation, struct/array attribute constants, and non-dense ElementsAttr forms accepted by MLIR. Its scalar float-constant result restriction is also narrower.

groups.title: llvm.mlir.zero
groups.description: Veir misses target-extension `HasZeroInit` checks and rejects void/function results accepted by MLIR verification.

groups.title: llvm.mlir.global
groups.description: Veir misses global-type/placement rules, nonnegative address spaces, string initializer type/length, target-extension restrictions, and the array requirement for appending linkage. Veir misses single-block/return-terminator and initializer side-effect checks, plus most additional property constraints, including unit-valued `thread_local_`. Veir accepts unrecognized nonzero common-linkage initializers, but rejects negative floating zero accepted by MLIR.

groups.title: llvm.mlir.addressof
groups.description: Veir misses address-space agreement and rejects alias/ifunc targets accepted by MLIR.

groups.title: llvm.intr.bswap
groups.description: Veir restricts widths to 16, 32, or 64; MLIR verification accepts others, such as i128.

groups.title: llvm.intr.vector.reduce.or
groups.description: Veir requires a scalar result; MLIR’s element-type trait also accepts vector results.

groups.title: llvm.icmp
groups.description: Veir accepts non-i64 predicate attributes rejected by MLIR.

groups.title: llvm.trunc
groups.description: Veir requires narrowing, rejecting same-width/widening casts accepted by MLIR; it also accepts byte-to-byte casts rejected by MLIR.

groups.title: llvm.br
groups.description: Veir misses the ODS LLVM-type restriction on forwarded operands.

groups.title: llvm.cond_br
groups.description: Veir misses the i1 condition check, LLVM-type restriction on forwarded operands, and i32 segment/weight storage checks.

groups.title: llvm.switch
groups.description: Veir misses the integer selector, case count/type agreement, integer case elements, and i32 case-segment/weight checks.

groups.title: llvm.alloca
groups.description: Veir misses integer allocation-size, pointer-result, and target-extension memory-support checks.

groups.title: llvm.load
groups.description: Veir misses pointer-address and loadable-result constraints.

groups.title: llvm.store
groups.description: Veir misses pointer-address and loadable-value constraints.

groups.title: llvm.getelementptr
groups.description: Veir misses pointer/integer type constraints, i32 raw indices, valid GEP flag bits, and rejection of bare `inboundsFlag`. Veir misses aggregate traversal and constant/in-bounds struct-index checks.

groups.title: llvm.insertelement
groups.description: Veir rejects f80/f128 and non-native pointer-interface vector elements accepted by MLIR.

groups.title: llvm.call
groups.description: Veir misses direct symbol resolution/signatures, the requirement for a callee symbol or operand, indirect pointer checks, variadic rules, and LLVM operand/result types. Veir misses operand segmentation, bundle metadata, property types/enums, and the debug-location requirement.

groups.title: llvm.return
groups.description: Veir requires an immediate llvm.func/global parent; MLIR permits other placement, including nested regions under an LLVM function. Veir misses the universal LLVM-type and at-most-one-operand restrictions.

groups.title: llvm.func
groups.description: Veir misses FunctionOpInterface entry-signature, argument/result attribute, and dialect callback checks, plus LLVM-compatible definition entry types. Veir misses linkage rules, conflicting definition attributes, exception-type consistency, and block-tag uniqueness. Veir permits signature components/multiple results rejected by LLVMFunctionType and leaves most additional property constraints unchecked.

groups.title: llvm.module_flags
groups.description: Veir misses module placement, ModuleFlagAttrInterface requirements, key/value schemas, and duplicate non-Require keys.

groups.title: llvm.freeze
groups.description: Veir requires exact type equality; MLIR’s type trait does not compare vector scalability flags.

groups.title: llvm.bitcast
groups.description: Veir enforces equal computed widths, rejecting nonpointer width changes accepted by MLIR. Veir accepts pointer/integer, cross-address-space pointer, and pointer-to-single-element-pointer-vector casts rejected by MLIR; its pointer width is hardcoded to 64. Veir accepts aggregate/unsupported-type pairs when both widths are unknown.

groups.title: llvm.intr.abs
groups.description: Veir requires the result type to equal the operand type; MLIR does not.
